title: The Compact, ∼1 kpc Host Galaxy of a Quasar at a Redshift of 7.1
question: What are the size, structure, kinematics, heating source and dynamical mass of the host galaxy of the z=7.1 quasar J1120+0641, as seen at ~1 kpc resolution in [C II] and dust continuum?

data.bands: [C II] at 235.07 GHz observed; continuum at 227 GHz (1.3 mm)
data.sensitivity: 0.15 mJy/beam per 20 MHz (full, natural); 0.17 mJy/beam per 20 MHz (robust=0.5)

what.value: Earlier PdBI [C II] flux 1.03±0.14 Jy km/s and S235GHz=0.61±0.16 mJy, for comparison

evidence.quote: is consistent with the value of F [CII] = 1.03±0.14Jy km s [−][1] published by Venemans et al. (2012)
the black hole with a mass of M BH = (2.4 ± 0.2) × 10 [9] M ⊙ [2] (De Rosa et al. 2014)

what.value: PDR and XDR [C II]/[C I] model line ratios

evidence.quote: In PDR models, the [C II ]/[C I ] ratio covers a large range from ∼3–50, depending on the density and strength of the UV radiation field

external_data.citation: Kaufman et al. 1999; Meijerink et al. 2007

what.value: [C II] SFR conversion for high-z sources

evidence.quote: Applying the [C II ] SFR conversion for high redshift sources from De Looze et al. (2014)

recipe.goal: Make continuum map and measure flux
recipe.method: Average channels >=0.75 GHz from [C II]; taper to 1.9 arcsec for total flux; aperture photometry
Tapered cube to 1.9 arcsec, extract peak-pixel spectrum, fit Gaussian+constant
2D Gaussian fits to continuum map and to [C II] map averaged over 600 km/s; aperture photometry; red/blue maps

recipe.goal: Upper limits on CO and [C I]
recipe.method: uvcontsub, average over 400 km/s, 3 sigma limits corrected for line wings
Intrinsic line fluxes corrected for CMB contrast; compare [C II]/[C I] with PDR/XDR models
assumptions: T_gas = T_dust; Td = 47, 41 or 30 K; constant dust temperature

recipe.goal: FIR luminosity, SFR, dust and gas mass
recipe.method: Optically thin modified blackbody, FIR 42.5-122.5 um, TIR 8-1000 um, SFR from Murphy+2011; dust mass with kappa from Dunne+2000; gas mass from CO limit
assumptions: beta=1.6 or 1.95; alpha_CO = 0.8 Msun/(K km/s pc2); L'CO(1-0)=L'CO(2-1)

recipe.method: Virial theorem Mdyn = 3R sigma^2/2G, R=4.3 kpc, sigma from tapered spectrum
assumptions: No ordered rotation, so virial rather than disk model

answer_key.quantity: CO(7-6) and [C I] 3 sigma upper limit

evidence.quote: We estimate a SFR of 105–340 M ⊙ yr [−][1] (Table 2)
